liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **New Speedway Boogie** (4 reviews): Follows Victim with a very soulful Speedway Boogie; Runs about fourteen minutes and is called the highlight of an otherwise lackluster show [6][7][9][14]
- **Victim Or The Crime** (2 reviews): Second set opens with a rocking Victim, with a drum intro the reviewer enjoys; Reviewer finds the Victim really amazing [6][9]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer would like a soundboard to hear the Drums and Space segment [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-02-25.aud.seff.4777.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 17 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd95-02-25.aud.5494.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 162 min; rated 2.6/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is boomy, typical of Oakland Arena audience tapes; The original set had sector boundary errors on all tracks, which the fixed version addresses [2][7]
- **gd1995-02-25.akg.flaschner.91223.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 163 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: The Flaschner AKG audience recording is considered the better audience source for this show; Best of three available versions, but audience noise is louder than the band at exciting moments [14][17]
- **gd1995-02-25.143162.pset2.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 4 songs; 30 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended; it was their last Dead show and the 20th they saw after Brent's death [7]
- Attendee of all three nights found the first night and second night's first set awful, until the band suddenly played well [9]
- Attendee, rarely at post-Brent shows, felt while dancing that the fun was over and this would be their last show [13]
- Reviewer was outside and could not get in, having seen Jerry at the wharf field shortly before [16]
- Reviewer calls it the best of the three Oakland nights, with the band and Jerry playing better than the night before [6]
- Reviewer says the first night was reportedly even worse than this show [8]
- Second set is considered great while the first set is weak; a soundboard of set two is sought [14]
- Reviewer says the band's energy is high and wants a soundboard [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-02-25.aud.seff.4777.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: Unknown Mics > DAT @48k [1]
- **gd95-02-25.aud.5494.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff and Chris L.; source: Audience [2]. Also: Unknown mics to DAT at 48k; transferred via DA-20mkII, Hosa S/PDIF, Delta DiO 2496, Peak, WAV, then SHN; Transferred, shortened and seeded by Jon Seff; this is a shntool-fixed version of an earlier SHN set [2]
- **gd1995-02-25.akg.flaschner.91223.flac16**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Chris Davis; source: (OTS) AKG 460b/ck61 -> custom pre-amp -> D-7 [4]
- **gd1995-02-25.143162.pset2.sbd.miller.flac1644**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Dat (cloned from vault master) [5]. Also: Second-set soundboard filler found on a DAT lent by David Gans [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - February 25, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/february-25-1995) [19]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1995-02-26 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-02-26-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [20]
- Poster by Original Concert Posters: [Grateful Dead Concert Poster Oakland Coliseum 1995](https://originalconcertposters.org/2026/05/grateful-dead-concert-poster-oakland-coliseum-1995/) [21]
